about: The site's independent parts. Every file belongs to one area (first match wins). Each learning track is an area of its own, read from tracks.js, so a new track needs no edit here. The scope guard (scripts/scope-guard.mjs) uses this map. Generated files belong to every area.

areas.about: The How it works page, its status API (What changed shows agent runs)
Home page, shared layout, nav, widgets and search
The AI glossary and concept map
The agents: workflows, scripts, schemas, evals and the branch rules
The rules and style guide, notes intake and docs

writer/.why: A lesson draft may change one track and nothing else.

reader/.why: The intern's wording fixes may change one track and nothing else.

improver/.why: The improvement agent makes one change in one area per pull request.

optimizer/.why: The efficiency agent makes one focused improvement, in at most two areas.
